title: SecOps-NG Asset Inventory Delta Evidence Artifact
description: Typed shape for one evidence artifact emitted by the asset-inventory-delta evidence stream. One artifact is produced per scheduled reconciliation execution of `playbook.asset_management@v1` and pins, mechanically, (a) the reconciled operator-authoritative snapshot id for the window, (b) the per-asset delta set against the previous documented snapshot, (c) the per-delta classification against the closed delta taxonomy (`new-managed`, `unmanaged-discovered`, `decommissioned`, `baseline-drift`), and (d) the counted unmanaged-discovered cardinality the NIS2 Article 21(2)(i) reviewer consumes as the exception bucket. The artifact is compile-target-agnostic: the deterministic `artifact_id` keys on `<workflow_id>|<execution_id>|<captured_at>` and does NOT include the compile target, so the three reference compilers (n8n, Temporal, LangGraph) re-derive byte-identical bytes from the same primitive output. Public-bar artifact: asset identifiers stay opaque operator-side strings; individual personal names, credential-shaped strings, and raw configuration secret material are out of scope per AGENTS.md §3.

schema_version.description: Pinned schema version. Lets a consumer reject artifacts produced under an older schema once breaking changes ship.

artifact_id.description: Stable per-artifact identifier. Convention: SHA-256 hex digest of `<workflow_id>|<execution_id>|<captured_at>` (UTF-8, no separators around the pipes). Deterministic on those three inputs; re-emissions inside the same execution at the same `captured_at` instant stay byte-identical at the path level. Compile target is intentionally NOT part of the id so the three reference compilers re-derive byte-identical bytes from the same primitive output (this is the byte-parity contract the F-WF-ASSET CORE-FANOUT siblings assert against).

stream.description: Identifies which evidence stream produced the artifact. Constant on this schema.

workflow_id.description: Stable workflow identifier; pinned to `asset_management` for this stream.

execution_id.description: Per-execution identifier issued by the compile target's workflow runtime (n8n execution id, Temporal workflow run id, LangGraph thread/checkpoint id).

regulation_refs.description: Pins to the upstream regulatory mapping entries this artifact helps satisfy. The asset_management playbook anchors against `nis2:art-21-2-i` (human resources security, access-control policies, and asset management).

control_refs.description: Control stable-ids attested by this artifact. The asset_management playbook anchors against `control.asset_inventory_delta@v1`.

snapshot_window.description: Identifier of the reconciliation window this run discharges. Operator-defined opaque string naming which inventory cohort the run reconciled against (scheduled-cadence reference, on-demand reconciliation reference, or operator-initiated trigger).

snapshot_id.description: Deterministic identifier of the operator-authoritative snapshot the reconcile step composed for this window. Derived inside the reconcile primitive as SHA-256 over a canonical, source-precedence-ordered, normalised asset set; two replays of the same window over the same source set produce byte-identical snapshot ids.

source_set_id.description: Deterministic identifier of the consulted inventory-source set (the sorted, deduplicated set of `source_id` values the ingest step pulled from). Derived inside the reconcile primitive as SHA-256 over the canonical sorted `(source_id, source_kind)` pair list. Empty source sets are rejected upstream.

delta_set.description: Per-asset delta set against the previous documented snapshot. Empty array is valid (no-change reconciliation) and emitted explicitly so the audit-evident chain is closed.

delta_classification.description: Per-delta classification against the closed delta taxonomy. The list ordering matches `delta_set` 1:1 (same length, same order). When the classification step short-circuited under the documented reconciliation deadline this field carries the single sentinel entry `["unclassified"]` (see `unclassified` enum value) and the consuming reviewer treats the delta set as unmanaged-discovered for notification urgency.

unmanaged_discovered_count.description: Pre-computed count of `unmanaged-discovered` entries in `delta_classification`. This is the NIS2 Art. 21(2)(i) exception-bucket cardinality the inventory-owner notification step pages on against the operator's documented threshold.

captured_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC second-precision timestamp at which this artifact was captured. Part of `artifact_id` so two captures at the same instant against the same execution stay byte-identical, and re-runs at different instants do not collide.

provenance.description: Where this artifact came from. Mirrors the provenance pattern used by the other evidence streams so a reviewer can re-derive the chain back to source.

source_url.description: URL of the workflow run that produced this artifact. Compile targets may use their own run-id URLs; the URL itself is opaque to this schema.

captured_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp matching the artifact-level `captured_at`.

commit_sha.description: Optional commit SHA of the content snapshot the workflow walked.

owner.description: Optional dated ownership pointer for the asset-management posture this artifact covers. Role-shaped — a working-group mailbox, a generic role title, or a community handle. Individual personal names are out of scope per AGENTS.md §3 and rejected here as a matter of schema discipline.

retention.description: Optional retention pointer the operator declares for this evidentiary record. ISO-8601 duration, defaulted by the operator's configuration.

delta_record.description: One per-asset delta entry. Each record names the asset identifier, the sources that observed it (source-attribution carry from the reconcile step, preserved in source-precedence order), the previous and current state markers, and the change kind that triggered the delta. `baseline_hash_previous` / `baseline_hash_current` are present iff the change-kind covers a baseline observation.

asset_id.description: Opaque operator-side asset identifier. Role-shaped or URN-shaped; personal-name strings rejected at the primitive boundary.

change_kind.description: Closed enumeration of delta change-kinds: `appeared` (asset present in current snapshot, absent from previous), `disappeared` (asset present in previous, absent from current), `baseline_diverged` (asset present in both, observed baseline hash differs).

previous_state.description: Closed enumeration of state markers for the previous snapshot.

current_state.description: Closed enumeration of state markers for the current snapshot.

source_attribution.description: Sources that observed the asset, preserved in operator-documented precedence order (highest-precedence first). At least one entry; deduplicated.

baseline_hash_previous.description: Optional hex digest of the observed baseline at the previous snapshot. Present iff the change-kind is `disappeared` or `baseline_diverged`.

baseline_hash_current.description: Optional hex digest of the observed baseline at the current snapshot. Present iff the change-kind is `appeared` or `baseline_diverged`.
